messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Can't find the LQHPT option
parts:
Hi, thanks for asking.
As of now, Wallace only includes Linear (L), Quadratic (Q), Product (P), Hinge (H), and combinations of those feature classes, for Maxent modeling. Otherwise, you can use ENMeval outside of Wallace to run a LQHPT model. Check out the ENMeval vignette and this article on MaxEnt for more info.
